title: StageRecord
description: One stage as the document stores it.

version.description: The version of the stage's contract: which schema its settings and output follow.

depends_on.description:
The hash of the input the stage read, so staleness can be worked out on load. Absent until
the stage has run.

settings.description: The settings the stage ran with (or will run with).

output.description: What the stage returned. Absent until the stage has run.

by_reach.description: The volumes by reach, as the volumes stage stored them.

station_m.description: The station step, m: each station stands for this length.

stations.description: The stored stations, in order of chainage: each reach holds the next `stations` of them.

volumes_fresh.description: True when the volumes stage is fresh: nothing it read has changed since it ran.

rates.description: The rates table, if the run has one.

ReachVolumes.description: The volumes of one reach: a stretch of the water stage's (one source, one pool).

from.description: Design-line chainage where the reach starts.

source.description: Where its water level comes from.

pool.description: The pool, by its index in the water stage's input, when it is one.

stations.description: The number of stations in it. A station at the boundary of two reaches is in the upper one.

weighted_dredge_m3.description: The dredge weighted by the cut-rate multiplier (ticket 13); absent with no multiplier.

weighted_excav_m3.description: The dry cut weighted by the multiplier.

Chainage.description:
Distance along a river or a design line, in metres. Chainage 0 is at the river mouth when the river
states one (spec 0017); with no mouth stated, it is at the start of the line as it was given.

oneOf.description: The water profile of the inputs.
A pool held by a structure.
The river's own level, outside every pool.

Between two pools that do not touch: read straight from the lower pool's level to the upper
one's (how the optimise stage's pools have always been read).

CostStation.description: One stored station's cut, as the cost reads it (the volumes stage's station has more).

weighted_dredge_area_m2.description: The weighted areas, when the volumes have them (ticket 13).

RatesTable.description:
The rates table: one rate per item, in one currency. A rate left out is refused when the cost is
worked out, never read as zero.

dredge_per_m3.description: Per m³ of dredge (cut in the river).

dry_cut_per_m3.description: Per m³ of dry cut (cut on land).

disposal_per_m3.description: Per m³ of all cut, for its disposal.

haul_per_m3_km.description: Per m³ of all cut per km hauled.

haul_km.description: The haul distance of the run, km: for every station no stretch covers.

haul_by_reach.description: Haul distances of stretches of design-line chainage, not overlapping.

Money.description:
An amount of money and its currency.

An amount is checked when it is made (`Money::new`) and again when it is read from JSON.

amount.description: The amount, in the currency's main unit.

HaulStretch.description: A haul distance for one stretch of design-line chainage.

reach.description: The stretch of design-line chainage, ends included. Each station in it hauls this distance.

Reach.description:
A stretch of river or design line between two chainages.

A reach is checked when it is made (`Reach::new`) and again when it is read from JSON.

from.description: The chainage where the reach starts.

to.description:
The chainage where the reach ends. Not below `from` (JSON Schema cannot state a relation
between two fields, so the reader checks it).

currency.description: The rates table's currency: every figure is in it.

by_reach.description: The cost of each reach, in the volumes' order.

totals.description: Each item added over the reaches.

level.description: The output level the totals reached (the lowest reach's); set by ticket 17.

cut_volumes.description:
Which volumes dredge and dry cut were priced on: `weighted` when the volumes hold the cut
weighted by the cut-rate multiplier, else `plain`.

ReachCost.description: The cost of one reach of the volumes stage.

from.description: Design-line chainage where the reach starts.

haul_m3_km.description: The reach's cut times its haul distance, summed station by station, m³·km.

level.description: The output level this figure reached; set by the design measures stage (ticket 17).

CostItems.description: The cost of each item, and their sum.

OutputLevel.description:
How far a run's figures can be trusted (spec 0017): the inputs each reach has decide the level it
reaches. Ordered from the lowest.

oneOf.description: Banks (or a river polygon) and an open elevation model.
Plus spot levels or a partial survey, and a rates table.
Plus bathymetry and a ground survey covering the reach.

CutVolumes.description: Which volumes dredge and dry cut were priced on.

oneOf.description: The plain volumes: the run has no cut-rate multiplier.
The volumes weighted by the cut-rate multiplier.
